findings.note: Ward Johnson authored HB 3691, relating to electronic submission of an application for an early voting ballot by mail by certain persons. It was left pending in the Elections Committee on 2025-05-08. Filing date taken from the earliest history entry on the page.

findings.passage: Would allow eligible voters—particularly seniors and those with mobility challenges—to request a vote-by-mail application through a secure online portal.
findings.note: From her campaign site Legislative Updates page describing her HB 3691. The same entry adds: "Simplifies the voting process for older adults and people with disabilities, reducing paperwork and barriers to civic participation while keeping the process secure and accessible." It does not mention ID.
